ma.setBackgroundColor(Object object)

Dynamically set the background color of a window

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
backgroundColor String No Background color of the window. The value must be a hexadecimal number.
backgroundColorTop String No Background color of the top of the window. The value must be a hexadecimal number. This parameter is supported only by iOS.
backgroundColorBottom String No Background color of the bottom of the window. The value must be a hexadecimal number. This parameter is supported only by iOS.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

Sample Code

    ma.setBackgroundColor({
      backgroundColor: '#ffffff', // The background color of the window is white.
    })
    
    ma.setBackgroundColor({
      backgroundColorTop: '#ffffff', // The background color of the top of the window is white.
      backgroundColorBottom: '#ffffff', // The background color of the bottom of the window is white.
    })
